profile.name: DMG-CPU-B
profile.applicability: Deterministic emulator profile; not evidence of boot-ROM execution or hardware conformance
profile.cpu_handoff: A=01 F=B0 B=00 C=13 D=00 E=D8 H=01 L=4D PC=0100 SP=FFFE for this nonzero header checksum
profile.io_handoff: DIV=AB STAT=85 as profile values; this tracer does not implement I/O behavior
profile.ram_policy: Emulator-defined zero fill; hardware WRAM/HRAM power-up contents are unspecified

protocol.guest_ram_write: Write 0x5A to 0xA000, read it back and compare
protocol.success: 0xA001=0xA5 after the compare succeeds; loop at 0x015F

scope_limits: No general DMG CPU support beyond the listed reachable opcodes
No CGB, I/O devices, display, audio, mapper, save, or gameplay claim
This fixture is profile validation, not a hardware oracle
